mapper.sql: id, catalog_id, parent_id, major_code, major_name, normalized_name, item_level, degree_category, sort_no, raw_data, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id AS id, i.catalog_id AS catalogId, i.parent_id AS parentId, p.major_name AS parentName, i.major_code AS majorCode, i.major_name AS majorName, i.item_level AS itemLevel, i.degree_category AS degreeCategory, i.sort_no AS sortNo FROM major_catalog_item i LEFT JOIN major_catalog_item p ON i.parent_id = p.id
ORDER BY i.sort_no ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT i.id AS itemId, c.id AS catalogId, c.catalog_code AS catalogCode, c.catalog_name AS catalogName, c.catalog_type AS catalogType, c.education_level AS educationLevel, i.major_code AS majorCode, i.major_name AS majorName, i.item_level AS itemLevel, i.degree_category AS degreeCategory, p.major_code AS parentCode, p.major_name AS parentName FROM major_catalog_item i INNER JOIN major_catalog c ON i.catalog_id = c.id LEFT JOIN major_catalog_item p ON i.parent_id = p.id WHERE c.enabled = 1 AND ( i.major_code = #{keyword} OR i.major_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.normalized_name = #{normalizedKeyword} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM major_alias a WHERE a.major_catalog_item_id = i.id AND a.normalized_alias IN (#{keyword}, #{normalizedKeyword}) ) ) ORDER BY c.priority ASC, i.major_code ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO major_catalog_item (catalog_id, parent_id, major_code, major_name, normalized_name, item_level, degree_category, sort_no, raw_data, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{catalogId}, #{parentId}, #{majorCode}, #{majorName}, #{normalizedName}, #{itemLevel}, #{degreeCategory}, #{sortNo}, #{rawData}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM major_catalog_item WHERE catalog_id = #{catalogId}
